note: Lawrence County MO states it has no zoning restrictions and publishes no zoning layer. Its largest city, Mount Vernon, publishes its official zoning district map only as a static PDF (2016 SMCOG map); no ArcGIS service, GeoJSON or shapefile for zoning districts was found for Mount Vernon, Aurora, Monett or Pierce City. The county's Geocortex/ArcGIS assessor service lists parcel and district layers but no zoning layer was reachable.
